title: triad-sdk-ux: stream iterables, token refresh, and graceful backoff
author: Amina Patel
release_notes: SDKs (Python/TypeScript/Go): improved streaming ergonomics with iterator helpers, unified token-refresh hook for long-lived streams, and a conservative exponential backoff default for transient RPC failures. Small API adapter applied to TS streaming callbacks for backward compatibility. Patch bumps: python 0.9.7->0.9.8, ts 1.4.0->1.4.1, go v0.6.0->v0.6.1.
description: Motivation: customers building long-lived streaming integrations reported subtle auth timeouts and poor ergonomics when resuming streams after transient network errors. This PR implements a cross-SDK approach: 1) iterator-style streaming helper for Python and Go and an async-iterable adapter for TypeScript to make consumption consistent; 2) a single pluggable token-refresh hook used by all streaming transports so refresh events can be handled without dropping consumer iterators; 3) a conservative default retry/backoff policy for transient transport errors (5 retries, jittered exponential backoff, per-request circuit window) plus safe guards to avoid duplicate emissions. Checklist: - [x] Implement Python streaming iterator and unit tests - [x] Implement TypeScript async-iterable adapter and compatibility shim - [x] Implement Go streaming iterator and context-aware token refresh - [x] Add token refresh hook API and wire into transports - [x] Ship default backoff policy and document overrides - [x] Bump package versions and CHANGELOG entries - [x] Run integration against staging and benchmark for tail latency Results/impact: unified consumption pattern across SDKs simplifies internal examples and reduces common user errors (resume semantics improved); no observable median latency regression in serving benchmarks, tail latency improved in presence of transient failures due to fewer hard disconnects. Commits summary: Implement iterator helpers and tests (python + go), Add TS async-iterable adapter with compatibility shim, Extract token refresh hook and plumb through transports, Introduce default RetryPolicy and Backoff util, Update CHANGELOGs and bump versions, Address reviewer feedback and fix flaky stream test. Files changed (high-level): sdk/python/redwood/streaming.py, sdk/python/tests/test_stream_resume.py, sdk/ts/src/stream/async_iterable_adapter.ts, sdk/ts/src/auth/token_refresh.ts, sdk/go/stream/iterator.go, sdk/go/auth/refresh.go, sdk/shared/retries/backoff.go, sdk/shared/retries/policy.go, docs/sdk/streaming.md, CHANGELOGs for python/ts/go. Review/feedback thread: "Ethan Zhao (2026-02-20): nice consolidation. Can we keep the TS callback signature backwards-compatible?" Author reply: "Amina (2026-02-21): added a lightweight shim so existing callbacks keep working; tests added to cover both styles." "Marta Kowalski (2026-02-24): tests look good but one flaky test failed on CI; can you make the integration test less timing-sensitive?" Author reply: "Amina (2026-02-25): replaced sleep-based assertion with event-driven latch; reran pipeline." "Connor Lee (2026-02-27): suggest making the default retries more conservative (fewer retries) for hosted tier to avoid cost regression" Author reply: "Amina (2026-02-28): lowered default to 5 retries and added per-tenant override hook in config." CI summary: initial run reported one flaky stream test failure in TS suite (stream-resume-should-not-duplicate) which was fixed and pipelines re-run; full matrix now green. Merge: squash and merge on 2026-03-01. Backports/Follow-ups: opened ENG-1612 for adding SDK telemetry around stream resume events and ENG-1698 to add a small perf test harness for streaming tail-latency; will follow up with a Dedicated-config recommendation doc for backoff settings in high-throughput environments.
